RegionGenie_ModelFiles_Browse.name: Browse… for model files
RegionGenie_ModelFiles_Browse.tooltip:
Off (default): A model-file field opens ComfyUI's menu of the files in ComfyUI's model folders.
On: Each field also gets a folder button (Browse…) that picks a file anywhere on the ComfyUI machine (saved by its full path), in these Settings (once the dialog is opened again), on the node's Edit rows and in the LLM settings. Files picked with it keep working when it is off.

RegionGenie_ModelFiles_Check.name: Check model files
RegionGenie_ModelFiles_Check.tooltip: Looks up every model file set in these Settings (Control, Edit Mode, Select object) and in the LLM presets, and lists the ones ComfyUI can't find (moved, renamed or deleted).

RegionGenie_Autocomplete_DefaultOn.name: Tag autocomplete on in new Region Genie nodes
RegionGenie_Autocomplete_DefaultOn.tooltip: Default for the 'autocomplete' switch on the Region Genie and Regional LoRAs nodes (nodes where you set the switch yourself keep their own choice). The autocomplete itself comes from ComfyUI-Custom-Scripts (preferred when enabled) or ComfyUI-Lora-Manager and follows that pack's settings.

RegionGenie_LLM_Context.name: What the LLM Prompt Enhancer sees
RegionGenie_LLM_Context.tooltip: Default for Region Genie nodes whose LLM Settings say 'Settings default'. With context, the LLM also gets scene_prompt_positive and the other regions' prompts (to keep them consistent) but only rewrites the one prompt.

options.The prompt + the scene and the other reg: The prompt + the scene and the other regions

RegionGenie_LLM_NewRegionsOn.name: New regions start with the LLM Prompt Enhancer on

RegionGenie_LLM_Default_character.name: Default preset: Character
RegionGenie_LLM_Default_character.tooltip: The preset for character prompts in every Region Genie node whose LLM settings don't choose another.

RegionGenie_LLM_Default_object.name: Default preset: Object
RegionGenie_LLM_Default_object.tooltip: The preset for object prompts in every Region Genie node whose LLM settings don't choose another.

RegionGenie_LLM_Default_text.name: Default preset: Text
RegionGenie_LLM_Default_text.tooltip: The preset for text prompts in every Region Genie node whose LLM settings don't choose another.

RegionGenie_LLM_Default_scene.name: Default preset: Scene
RegionGenie_LLM_Default_scene.tooltip: The preset for scene prompts in every Region Genie node whose LLM settings don't choose another.

RegionGenie_LLM_EditPreset.name: Preset to edit
RegionGenie_LLM_EditPreset.tooltip:
The preset the rows below show and change (saved at once, for all your workflows).
New: A copy of this preset under a new name.
Delete: Removes it (not while it is a default above; click twice).

RegionGenie_LLM_Preset_name.name: Preset: name
RegionGenie_LLM_Preset_name.tooltip: The preset's name. Press Enter (or leave the field) to rename it; the defaults above follow.

RegionGenie_LLM_Preset_llm.name: Preset: LLM
RegionGenie_LLM_Preset_llm.tooltip:
The LLM that rewrites the prompts.
The connected clip: Used as it is (no extra memory).
A file: From ComfyUI's text_encoders folders (or anywhere with 'Browse… for model files' on, Model files); loaded once and kept while in use.

RegionGenie_LLM_Preset_llm_type.name: Preset: LLM type
RegionGenie_LLM_Preset_llm_type.tooltip: As the 'type' of Load CLIP, for an LLM file. Auto works for plain Qwen3 / Qwen3.5 / Gemma files.

RegionGenie_LLM_Preset_loras.name: Preset: LLM LoRAs
RegionGenie_LLM_Preset_loras.tooltip:
LoRAs applied to the LLM only (like Load LoRA (Text Encoder)); the image model and the clip used for conditioning are not changed. 
Each row: On / off, the file (a click opens ComfyUI's menu; a folder button with 'Browse… for model files' on), strength, ✕ removes it.

RegionGenie_LLM_Preset_system_prompt.name: Preset: system prompt
RegionGenie_LLM_Preset_system_prompt.tooltip: Sent as the system prompt (Generate Text's system_prompt). Ignored when the preset's default template is off.

RegionGenie_LLM_Preset_sampling.name: Preset: sampling
RegionGenie_LLM_Preset_sampling.tooltip:
On: Sampling with the settings below.
Off (default): Greedy decoding, always the same text for the same input; temperature, top_k, top_p, min_p, the penalties and the seed are not used.

RegionGenie_LLM_Preset_temperature.name: Preset: temperature
RegionGenie_LLM_Preset_temperature.tooltip:
Sampling temperature.
Used only while the preset's sampling is on (greyed otherwise).

RegionGenie_LLM_Preset_top_k.name: Preset: top_k
RegionGenie_LLM_Preset_top_k.tooltip:
Sample from the k most likely tokens (0 = all).
Used only while the preset's sampling is on (greyed otherwise).

RegionGenie_LLM_Preset_top_p.name: Preset: top_p
RegionGenie_LLM_Preset_top_p.tooltip:
Sample from the most likely tokens up to this total probability.
Used only while the preset's sampling is on (greyed otherwise).

RegionGenie_LLM_Preset_min_p.name: Preset: min_p
RegionGenie_LLM_Preset_min_p.tooltip:
Leave out tokens less likely than this share of the most likely one.
Used only while the preset's sampling is on (greyed otherwise).

RegionGenie_LLM_Preset_repetition_penalt.name: Preset: repetition_penalty
RegionGenie_LLM_Preset_repetition_penalt.tooltip:
Penalty for repeating tokens (1 = none).
Used only while the preset's sampling is on (greyed otherwise).

RegionGenie_LLM_Preset_presence_penalty.name: Preset: presence_penalty
RegionGenie_LLM_Preset_presence_penalty.tooltip:
Penalty for tokens already used (0 = none).
Used only while the preset's sampling is on (greyed otherwise).

RegionGenie_LLM_Preset_seed.name: Preset: seed
RegionGenie_LLM_Preset_seed.tooltip:
The seed (a region's right-click 'Run again with a new seed' adds to it for that region).
Used only while the preset's sampling is on (greyed otherwise).

RegionGenie_LLM_Preset_thinking.name: Preset: thinking
RegionGenie_LLM_Preset_thinking.tooltip: Thinking mode, if the model supports it (the reasoning is shown in the sparkles button's tooltip, not used).

RegionGenie_LLM_Preset_use_default_templ.name: Preset: default template
RegionGenie_LLM_Preset_use_default_templ.tooltip: Use the model's built-in chat template (needed for the system prompt).

RegionGenie_LLM_Preset_mtp.name: Preset: mtp
RegionGenie_LLM_Preset_mtp.tooltip: Speculative decoding with the model's multi-token-prediction head (no effect without MTP weights).

RegionGenie_LLM_CacheOnDisk.name: Keep LLM results on disk between ComfyUI restarts
RegionGenie_LLM_CacheOnDisk.tooltip:
Off (default): Enhanced prompts are kept in memory for this session, and in each workflow that used them (a saved workflow brings its own results back when it is opened), so re-running a workflow never needs the LLM again.
On: They are also saved to <ComfyUI user dir>/region_genie/llm_cache.json, which only helps workflows queued through the API without opening them. Turning this off deletes that file.

RegionGenie_LLM_CacheDays.name: Forget LLM results after (days; 0 = never)
RegionGenie_LLM_CacheDays.tooltip: Results older than this are dropped from the cache (memory and disk).

RegionGenie_LLM_CacheMaxEntries.name: Most LLM results to keep
RegionGenie_LLM_CacheMaxEntries.tooltip: Beyond this, the oldest results are dropped first (memory and disk).

RegionGenie_Tools_Lasso.name: Lasso: default
RegionGenie_Tools_Lasso.tooltip: Which lasso the Lasso button starts as in every Region Genie node. Right-clicking the button still switches it for the rest of the session.

options.Magnetic lasso (follows edges in the ima: Magnetic lasso (follows edges in the image)

RegionGenie_Tools_LassoErase.name: Lasso erase: default
RegionGenie_Tools_LassoErase.tooltip: Which lasso erase the Eraser button's list starts with in every Region Genie node. Right-clicking the button still switches it for the rest of the session.

options.Magnetic lasso erase (follows edges in t: Magnetic lasso erase (follows edges in the image)

RegionGenie_Tools_Wand.name: Magic wand: default
RegionGenie_Tools_Wand.tooltip:
What a click with the magic wand selects in the image.
Connected area of similar color: Only the area around the click.
Every similar color in the image: All pixels of that color, connected or not.
Right-clicking the button still switches it for the session.

options.Every similar color in the image: Every similar color in the image

RegionGenie_Tools_WandTolerance.name: Magic wand: tolerance
RegionGenie_Tools_WandTolerance.tooltip: How different a color may be from the clicked one (0-255 per channel) and still be selected. The field on the canvas (top left, while the wand is active) changes it for the session.

RegionGenie_Tools_Fill.name: Fill: default
RegionGenie_Tools_Fill.tooltip:
Closing small gaps: The fill doesn't leak out through openings narrower than about twice the gap size (the field on the canvas while Fill is active).
Right-clicking the button still switches it for the session.

RegionGenie_Tools_FillGap.name: Fill: gap size (px)
RegionGenie_Tools_FillGap.tooltip: Fill, closing small gaps: Openings narrower than about twice this many pixels are closed.

RegionGenie_Select_Model.name: Model
RegionGenie_Select_Model.tooltip: The SAM 3.1 checkpoint the Select object tool uses (ComfyUI's native SAM 3 support). Download sam3.1_multiplex_fp16.safetensors from huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/sam3.1 into ComfyUI/models/checkpoints. When this file isn't there, another SAM 3 checkpoint in that folder is used. With 'Browse… for model files' on (Model files), a folder button picks a checkpoint anywhere on the ComfyUI machine.

RegionGenie_Select_KeepLoaded.name: After a selection
RegionGenie_Select_KeepLoaded.tooltip:
Keep loaded: The model stays in memory for the session (about 1.7 GB). ComfyUI still moves it out of VRAM into system RAM when a workflow needs the room, and back on the next click.
Unload: The model is freed when you accept or cancel a selection (and after 3 idle minutes), so each new selection loads it from disk again.

options.Keep the model loaded (faster next time): Keep the model loaded (faster next time)
options.Unload the model after each selection: Unload the model after each selection

RegionGenie_Select_Threshold.name: Find all: confidence
RegionGenie_Select_Threshold.tooltip: Find all (typed text): How sure SAM must be that something matches to select it. Lower finds more (and more wrong things), higher finds fewer.

RegionGenie_Text_NodeScene.name: In the node: scene prompts
RegionGenie_Text_NodeScene.tooltip: Text size in px for the three scene_prompt boxes (0 = ComfyUI's own size); also the Regional LoRAs node's positive / negative boxes. Applies to every node.

RegionGenie_Text_NodeRegion.name: In the node: region prompts
RegionGenie_Text_NodeRegion.tooltip: Text size in px for the prompt fields in the region list (0 = the usual 12 px); also the Regional LoRAs node's row prompts. Applies to every node.

RegionGenie_Text_NodeText.name: In the node: text to render
RegionGenie_Text_NodeText.tooltip: Text size in px for the text-to-render fields in the region list (0 = the usual 12 px). Applies to every node.

RegionGenie_Text_PopupScene.name: Pop-up editor: scene prompts
RegionGenie_Text_PopupScene.tooltip: Text size in px for the text box of the scene prompts' pop-up editor (A− / A+ in its header change it too); also the Regional LoRAs node's pop-up for its positive / negative boxes. Applies to every node.

RegionGenie_Text_PopupRegion.name: Pop-up editor: region prompts
RegionGenie_Text_PopupRegion.tooltip: Text size in px for the Prompt box of the region pop-up editor (A− / A+ in its header change it too); also the Regional LoRAs node's pop-up for its row prompts. Applies to every node.

RegionGenie_Text_PopupText.name: Pop-up editor: text to render
RegionGenie_Text_PopupText.tooltip: Text size in px for the Text box of the region pop-up editor (A− / A+ in its header, with the Text box in use). Applies to every node.

RegionGenie_Popup_PrevKey.name: Pop-up editor: key for the previous text field
RegionGenie_Popup_PrevKey.tooltip:
Steps to the previous / next text field of the node while you type in a pop-up editor, like its ◀ / ▶ buttons. Default: Page Up.
Write a key as the browser names it, with modifiers before it: PageUp, PageDown, Alt+ArrowLeft, Alt+ArrowRight, Ctrl+PageUp, F2 … (Left / Right / Up / Down, PgUp / PgDn and Ctrl / Alt / Shift work too).
Empty: No key. Applies to every Region Genie and Regional LoRAs node.

RegionGenie_Popup_NextKey.name: Pop-up editor: key for the next text field
RegionGenie_Popup_NextKey.tooltip:
Steps to the previous / next text field of the node while you type in a pop-up editor, like its ◀ / ▶ buttons. Default: Page Down.
Write a key as the browser names it, with modifiers before it: PageUp, PageDown, Alt+ArrowLeft, Alt+ArrowRight, Ctrl+PageUp, F2 … (Left / Right / Up / Down, PgUp / PgDn and Ctrl / Alt / Shift work too).
Empty: No key. Applies to every Region Genie and Regional LoRAs node.

RegionGenie_Popup_EscKeeps.name: Esc in a pop-up editor
RegionGenie_Popup_EscKeeps.tooltip:
What Esc does in the pop-up text editors (every Region Genie and Regional LoRAs node).
Put the text back: Esc closes it and the text is as it was when it opened (Enter and ✕ keep the edits).
Keep the edits: Esc, Enter and ✕ all close it and keep the text.

RegionGenie_Wildcards_PerField.name: A seed per field
RegionGenie_Wildcards_PerField.tooltip:
Off: Every prompt field of a node uses the node's wildcard seed as it is (like Impact Pack nodes sharing one seed), so the same wildcard in two fields usually picks the same value.
On: Each field gets its own seed, derived from the wildcard seed and the field, so they pick independently (still the same result for the same seed).

RegionGenie_Size_Mode.name: Image size: mode
RegionGenie_Size_Mode.tooltip:
How a new node's image size is set.
aspect ratio: An aspect ratio and megapixels (like ComfyUI's Resolution Selector).
presets: A size from the presets list.
manual: Width and height typed in.
Applies to nodes added from now on; nodes already in a workflow keep their own value.

RegionGenie_Size_Aspect.name: Aspect ratio
RegionGenie_Size_Aspect.tooltip: Applies to nodes added from now on; nodes already in a workflow keep their own value.

RegionGenie_Size_Megapixels.name: Megapixels
RegionGenie_Size_Megapixels.tooltip: Target total megapixels (1.0 MP = 1024 x 1024 for square). Applies to nodes added from now on; nodes already in a workflow keep their own value.

RegionGenie_Size_Multiple.name: Multiple
RegionGenie_Size_Multiple.tooltip: Width and height are rounded to a multiple of this. Applies to nodes added from now on; nodes already in a workflow keep their own value.

RegionGenie_Size_Presets.name: Presets
RegionGenie_Size_Presets.tooltip: The sizes in the presets list of every Region Genie node, separated by ';', each as WIDTHxHEIGHT and an optional name (e.g. '1216x832 landscape'). It's easier to edit from the node, with the last entry of its presets list, 'Edit list…'.

RegionGenie_Main_Width.name: Manual: width
RegionGenie_Main_Width.tooltip: Applies to nodes added from now on; nodes already in a workflow keep their own value.

RegionGenie_Main_Height.name: Manual: height
RegionGenie_Main_Height.tooltip: Applies to nodes added from now on; nodes already in a workflow keep their own value.

RegionGenie_Main_ImageMode.name: image_mode
RegionGenie_Main_ImageMode.tooltip: Applies to nodes added from now on; nodes already in a workflow keep their own value.

RegionGenie_Main_MinRegionPixels.name: Color map: min region pixels
RegionGenie_Main_MinRegionPixels.tooltip: With the image used as a color map, a color becomes a region when it has at least this many flat pixels (blended edges go to the nearest region, specks of other colors become unspecified). Applies to every Region Genie node at its next run; the node's image control shows it too while 'color map' is chosen.

RegionGenie_Main_ImportMode.name: import_json when the canvas isn't empty
RegionGenie_Main_ImportMode.tooltip:
Ask before replacing: The run keeps the canvas and the node asks (Replace canvas / Keep canvas).
Always replace: The new layout replaces the canvas right away.
An empty canvas is always filled. Applies to every Region Genie node at its next run.

RegionGenie_Main_Feather.name: Feather (px, linked regions)
RegionGenie_Main_Feather.tooltip: Applies to nodes added from now on; nodes already in a workflow keep their own value.

RegionGenie_Main_RegionSeparation.name: LoRA region separation
RegionGenie_Main_RegionSeparation.tooltip: Applies to nodes added from now on; nodes already in a workflow keep their own value.

RegionGenie_Main_SeparationUntil.name: LoRA separation until
RegionGenie_Main_SeparationUntil.tooltip: Applies to nodes added from now on; nodes already in a workflow keep their own value.

RegionGenie_Main_AllRegionsApart.name: Keep all regions apart (not only those with LoRAs)
RegionGenie_Main_AllRegionsApart.tooltip: Applies to nodes added from now on; nodes already in a workflow keep their own value.

RegionGenie_Main_ShareBackground.name: Keep regions apart: share the background
RegionGenie_Main_ShareBackground.tooltip: Regions that are kept apart stay apart from each other, but not from the image around them, so lighting and setting stay one picture. Applies to nodes added from now on; nodes already in a workflow keep their own value.

RegionGenie_Main_AutoApart.name: Plain-text prompts: keep all regions apart automatically
RegionGenie_Main_AutoApart.tooltip:
Krea 2, Flux, Flux 3, Anima and SDXL / SD1.5 (and MOSS-Image in its standard mode and in Edit Mode) get the regions as plain sentences. The Region Genie node places each region by tying its sentence to its region in attention ('keep all regions apart').
On: With such a model on 'model', clip connected and at least one region prompt, a run keeps all regions apart, unless the node's button is set to 'Off for this node'.
Off: Only a node whose button is on keeps them apart.
The settings below change it for one model. Applies to every Region Genie node at its next run.

RegionGenie_Main_AutoApart_MOSS.name: MOSS-Image (standard mode, Edit Mode): keep all regions apart automatically
RegionGenie_Main_AutoApart_MOSS.tooltip: For MOSS-Image models only. 'As set for all models' follows the setting above.

RegionGenie_Main_AutoApart_Krea2.name: Krea 2: keep all regions apart automatically
RegionGenie_Main_AutoApart_Krea2.tooltip: For Krea 2 models only. 'As set for all models' follows the setting above.

RegionGenie_Main_AutoApart_Flux.name: Flux: keep all regions apart automatically
RegionGenie_Main_AutoApart_Flux.tooltip: For Flux models only. 'As set for all models' follows the setting above.

RegionGenie_Main_AutoApart_Flux3.name: Flux 3: keep all regions apart automatically
RegionGenie_Main_AutoApart_Flux3.tooltip: For Flux 3 models only. 'As set for all models' follows the setting above.

RegionGenie_Main_AutoApart_Anima.name: Anima: keep all regions apart automatically
RegionGenie_Main_AutoApart_Anima.tooltip: For Anima models only. 'As set for all models' follows the setting above.

RegionGenie_Main_AutoApart_SDXL.name: SDXL / SD1.5: keep all regions apart automatically
RegionGenie_Main_AutoApart_SDXL.tooltip: For SDXL / SD1.5 models only. 'As set for all models' follows the setting above.

RegionGenie_Main_Snap.name: Snap to grid on
RegionGenie_Main_Snap.tooltip: When a Region Genie node is added or a workflow is opened.

RegionGenie_Main_Grid.name: Grid size (image px)
RegionGenie_Main_Grid.tooltip: When a Region Genie node is added or a workflow is opened.

RegionGenie_Control_MOSS.name: MOSS-Image: color / depth control LoRA
RegionGenie_Control_MOSS.tooltip:
MOSS-Image's color / depth control adapter (a LoRA). It reads the regions' color map and / or a depth map, VAE-encoded next to the image (needs 'vae').
A node's Control row uses it (as a LoRA on the model) for MOSS-Image models.
Get moss_image_color_depth_control.safetensors into ComfyUI/models/loras: https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MOSS-Image/resolve/main/loras/moss_image_color_depth_control.safetensors
Or keep the file anywhere: With 'Browse… for model files' on (Model files), a folder button picks it where it is. The same for every Region Genie node.

RegionGenie_Control_Flux1Depth.name: Flux.1: depth LoRA (e.g. flux1-depth-dev-lora)
RegionGenie_Control_Flux1Depth.tooltip:
Black Forest Labs' structural LoRA for Flux.1 [dev]. The map is VAE-encoded next to the image (needs 'vae').
A node's Control row uses it (as a LoRA on the model) for Flux.1 models, at the row's strength.
Get flux1-depth-dev-lora.safetensors into ComfyUI/models/loras: https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/flux1-dev/resolve/main/split_files/loras/flux1-depth-dev-lora.safetensors
Or keep the file anywhere: With 'Browse… for model files' on (Model files), a folder button picks it where it is. The same for every Region Genie node.

RegionGenie_Control_Flux1Canny.name: Flux.1: canny LoRA (e.g. flux1-canny-dev-lora)
RegionGenie_Control_Flux1Canny.tooltip:
Black Forest Labs' structural LoRA for Flux.1 [dev]. The map is VAE-encoded next to the image (needs 'vae').
A node's Control row uses it (as a LoRA on the model) for Flux.1 models, at the row's strength.
Get flux1-canny-dev-lora.safetensors into ComfyUI/models/loras (Black Forest Labs' page asks you to accept the FLUX.1 [dev] license first): https://huggingface.co/black-forest-labs/FLUX.1-Canny-dev-lora/resolve/main/flux1-canny-dev-lora.safetensors
Or keep the file anywhere: With 'Browse… for model files' on (Model files), a folder button picks it where it is. The same for every Region Genie node.

RegionGenie_Control_Flux1_depth.name: Flux.1: depth ControlNet
RegionGenie_Control_Flux1_depth.tooltip:
A ControlNet, a separate network that reads the map and steers the model at each step, with the Control row's strength and start / end (also Control-LoRA and union files).
Used by the Control row when the model is Flux.1 and no Flux.1 depth LoRA is set (the LoRA comes first).
Get flux-depth-controlnet-v3.safetensors into ComfyUI/models/controlnet: https://huggingface.co/XLabs-AI/flux-controlnet-collections/resolve/main/flux-depth-controlnet-v3.safetensors
Or keep the file anywhere: With 'Browse… for model files' on (Model files), a folder button picks it where it is. The same for every Region Genie node.

RegionGenie_Control_Flux1_canny.name: Flux.1: canny ControlNet
RegionGenie_Control_Flux1_canny.tooltip:
A ControlNet, a separate network that reads the map and steers the model at each step, with the Control row's strength and start / end (also Control-LoRA and union files).
Used by the Control row when the model is Flux.1 and no Flux.1 canny LoRA is set (the LoRA comes first).
Get flux-canny-controlnet-v3.safetensors into ComfyUI/models/controlnet: https://huggingface.co/XLabs-AI/flux-controlnet-collections/resolve/main/flux-canny-controlnet-v3.safetensors
Or keep the file anywhere: With 'Browse… for model files' on (Model files), a folder button picks it where it is. The same for every Region Genie node.

RegionGenie_Control_Flux1_other.name: Flux.1: ControlNet for your control_image (pose, lineart, union …)
RegionGenie_Control_Flux1_other.tooltip:
A ControlNet, a separate network that reads the map and steers the model at each step, with the Control row's strength and start / end (also Control-LoRA and union files).
Used by the Control row when the model is Flux.1.
Get diffusion_pytorch_model.safetensors into ComfyUI/models/controlnet (InstantX's union ControlNet (pose, depth, canny, tile …); rename it, e.g. instantx-flux-union.safetensors): https://huggingface.co/InstantX/FLUX.1-dev-Controlnet-Union/resolve/main/diffusion_pytorch_model.safetensors
Or keep the file anywhere: With 'Browse… for model files' on (Model files), a folder button picks it where it is. The same for every Region Genie node.

RegionGenie_Control_SDXL_depth.name: SDXL: depth ControlNet
RegionGenie_Control_SDXL_depth.tooltip:
A ControlNet, a separate network that reads the map and steers the model at each step, with the Control row's strength and start / end (also Control-LoRA and union files).
Used by the Control row when the model is SDXL.
Get control-lora-depth-rank128.safetensors into ComfyUI/models/controlnet: https://huggingface.co/stabilityai/control-lora/resolve/main/control-LoRAs-rank128/control-lora-depth-rank128.safetensors
Or keep the file anywhere: With 'Browse… for model files' on (Model files), a folder button picks it where it is. The same for every Region Genie node.

RegionGenie_Control_SDXL_canny.name: SDXL: canny ControlNet
RegionGenie_Control_SDXL_canny.tooltip:
A ControlNet, a separate network that reads the map and steers the model at each step, with the Control row's strength and start / end (also Control-LoRA and union files).
Used by the Control row when the model is SDXL.
Get control-lora-canny-rank128.safetensors into ComfyUI/models/controlnet: https://huggingface.co/stabilityai/control-lora/resolve/main/control-LoRAs-rank128/control-lora-canny-rank128.safetensors
Or keep the file anywhere: With 'Browse… for model files' on (Model files), a folder button picks it where it is. The same for every Region Genie node.

RegionGenie_Control_SDXL_other.name: SDXL: ControlNet for your control_image (pose, lineart, union …)
RegionGenie_Control_SDXL_other.tooltip:
A ControlNet, a separate network that reads the map and steers the model at each step, with the Control row's strength and start / end (also Control-LoRA and union files).
Used by the Control row when the model is SDXL.
Get diffusion_pytorch_model_promax.safetensors into ComfyUI/models/controlnet (Xinsir's union ControlNet (pose, depth, canny, lineart …); rename it, e.g. controlnet-union-sdxl-promax.safetensors): https://huggingface.co/xinsir/controlnet-union-sdxl-1.0/resolve/main/diffusion_pytorch_model_promax.safetensors
Or keep the file anywhere: With 'Browse… for model files' on (Model files), a folder button picks it where it is. The same for every Region Genie node.

RegionGenie_Control_SD15_depth.name: SD1.5: depth ControlNet
RegionGenie_Control_SD15_depth.tooltip:
A ControlNet, a separate network that reads the map and steers the model at each step, with the Control row's strength and start / end (also Control-LoRA and union files).
Used by the Control row when the model is SD1.5.
Get control_v11f1p_sd15_depth_fp16.safetensors into ComfyUI/models/controlnet: https://huggingface.co/comfyanonymous/ControlNet-v1-1_fp16_safetensors/resolve/main/control_v11f1p_sd15_depth_fp16.safetensors
Or keep the file anywhere: With 'Browse… for model files' on (Model files), a folder button picks it where it is. The same for every Region Genie node.

RegionGenie_Control_SD15_canny.name: SD1.5: canny ControlNet
RegionGenie_Control_SD15_canny.tooltip:
A ControlNet, a separate network that reads the map and steers the model at each step, with the Control row's strength and start / end (also Control-LoRA and union files).
Used by the Control row when the model is SD1.5.

RegionGenie_Edit_Reference_MOSS.name: MOSS-Image: send the source image as a reference
RegionGenie_Edit_Reference_MOSS.tooltip:
On: In Edit Mode, the source image (on 'image') is also given to MOSS-Image as a reference image (reference_latents on positive and negative), as edit models such as MOSS-Image Edit expect.
Off: Image-to-image from the latent only.

Off: Image-to-image from the latent only.

RegionGenie_Edit_ReferenceSize.name: Reference image size (long edge, px; 0 = output size)
RegionGenie_Edit_ReferenceSize.tooltip: The reference image is scaled down to this long edge before it is encoded (never up). Larger is slower.

RegionGenie_Edit_MossFormat.name: MOSS-Image edit layout
RegionGenie_Edit_MossFormat.tooltip: How the reference is given to MOSS-Image (as in ComfyUI's TextEncodeMOSSImageEdit node). Auto: LoRAs trained with ai-toolkit (fused qkv weights) get 'ai-toolkit', others (e.g. the Moss-Image-Edit LoRA) get 'Moss-Image-Edit'.

RegionGenie_Edit_MaskGrow.name: Edit mask: grow (px; negative shrinks)
RegionGenie_Edit_MaskGrow.tooltip: The edit mask (what the sampler may change in Edit Mode) grows by this many pixels past the regions, so edits blend into their surroundings; negative values shrink it. Kept regions are never grown into. For nodes whose list header doesn't set their own value.

RegionGenie_Edit_MaskFeather.name: Edit mask: feather (px)
RegionGenie_Edit_MaskFeather.tooltip: Softens the edit mask's edge by this many pixels (after growing), independent of the regions' own feather. For nodes whose list header doesn't set their own value.

RegionGenie_RegionalLoRAs_Feather.name: feather
RegionGenie_RegionalLoRAs_Feather.tooltip: Applies to nodes added from now on; nodes already in a workflow keep their own value.

RegionGenie_Save_Format.name: format
RegionGenie_Save_Format.tooltip:
png: Lossless.
webp: Lossless or a quality, much smaller.
jpeg: A quality, small.
avif: A quality, smallest.
exr: 16 / 32-bit float, scene-linear (for compositing and HDR; not smaller).
Applies to nodes added from now on; nodes already in a workflow keep their own value.

RegionGenie_Save_PngLevel.name: PNG compression
RegionGenie_Save_PngLevel.tooltip: 0-9, lossless at every level. Higher = smaller file, slower save. Applies to nodes added from now on; nodes already in a workflow keep their own value.

RegionGenie_Save_WebpLossless.name: WebP lossless
RegionGenie_Save_WebpLossless.tooltip: The exact pixels, usually 25-35% smaller than PNG; off: WebP quality decides. Applies to nodes added from now on; nodes already in a workflow keep their own value.

RegionGenie_Save_WebpQuality.name: WebP quality
RegionGenie_Save_WebpQuality.tooltip: 1-100. Lower = smaller file, more detail lost. Applies to nodes added from now on; nodes already in a workflow keep their own value.

RegionGenie_Save_JpegQuality.name: JPEG quality
RegionGenie_Save_JpegQuality.tooltip: 1-100. Lower = smaller file, more detail lost. Applies to nodes added from now on; nodes already in a workflow keep their own value.

RegionGenie_Save_JpegExtension.name: JPEG extension
RegionGenie_Save_JpegExtension.tooltip: Applies to nodes added from now on; nodes already in a workflow keep their own value.

RegionGenie_Save_JpegWorkflow.name: JPEG workflow
RegionGenie_Save_JpegWorkflow.tooltip:
ComfyUI can't load a workflow from a JPEG.
sidecar .json: The workflow in a small .json file next to each JPEG (drag that file into ComfyUI to load it).
none: No workflow.
inside the JPEG (EXIF): Readable by other tools, not by ComfyUI.
Applies to nodes added from now on; nodes already in a workflow keep their own value.

RegionGenie_Save_AvifQuality.name: AVIF quality
RegionGenie_Save_AvifQuality.tooltip: 1-100. Lower = smaller file, more detail lost. Applies to nodes added from now on; nodes already in a workflow keep their own value.

RegionGenie_Save_ExrBitDepth.name: EXR bit depth
RegionGenie_Save_ExrBitDepth.tooltip:
16-bit float: Half precision, about half the size.
32-bit float: Full precision.
Applies to nodes added from now on; nodes already in a workflow keep their own value.

RegionGenie_Save_ExrColorSpace.name: EXR color space
RegionGenie_Save_ExrColorSpace.tooltip:
The color space of the images coming in (the EXR is always scene-linear).
sRGB: sRGB-encoded Rec.709, the usual.
HDR: HLG-encoded Rec.2020.
linear: Already scene-linear Rec.709.
linear ACEScg: Already scene-linear ACEScg.
Applies to nodes added from now on; nodes already in a workflow keep their own value.

RegionGenie_RegionalLoRAs_SeparationUnti.name: separation_until
RegionGenie_RegionalLoRAs_SeparationUnti.tooltip: Applies to nodes added from now on; nodes already in a workflow keep their own value.
